name: Avyakta
description: A place that will not resolve. Shapes hold for a moment and then read as something else — a wall becomes a row of posts, a post becomes a person standing, and settles again when you stop looking. The ground underfoot is the only thing that stays the same.

pois.label: Unsettled shapes
pois.text: Look straight at one and it is a stack of cut stone. Look slightly off it and it is a stooped figure. Whichever it is, it is the same height.

pois.label: Steady ground
pois.text: Flat, firm, and identical in every direction. No tracks hold in it and no shadow falls on it, and it is the only thing here you can be sure of.

pois.label: The second look
pois.text: Turn away and turn back and the arrangement has changed. Not much. Enough that the gap you walked through is a stone's width narrower than it was.
